name: opencode-permission-rule-set
body: An agent's opencode 2.x permission model: one ordered `permissions` array of `{ action, resource, effect }` rules, evaluated in order with the last matching rule deciding, in place of the V1 per-tool `permission` map. The action names carry opencode 2.x's vocabulary (`shell` where V1 used `bash`, `subagent` where V1 used `task`, `edit` where V1 used `write`/`patch`), and the per-tool grants over the apg suite and the opencode built-ins appear as action entries. The ordered rule set makes precedence and exceptions explicit: a later rule overrides an earlier one, so an allow broadened by a later deny narrows again. Each distributed and generated agent carries one such rule set.
